title: Issue, Activation and Replacement Terms for the Healthy Options Card
content:
The card itself — what it costs to have, how long the member has to bring it into use, and what a replacement costs and takes — is governed tier by tier across the Ridgecrest Healthy Options Card programmes.

| Card tier | First card | Replacement card | Business days for a replacement to reach the member | Business days for the first card to reach the member | The member must activate the card | Calendar days after issue to activate |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Core | 0.00 USD | 7.50 USD | 10 | 14 | yes | 90 |
| Select | 0.00 USD | 5.00 USD | 9 | 12 | yes | 90 |
| Plus | 0.00 USD | 0.00 USD | 7 | 10 | yes | 120 |
| Premier | 0.00 USD | 0.00 USD | 7 | 10 | yes | 120 |
| Dual Complete | 0.00 USD | 0.00 USD | 5 | 8 | no | 180 |
| Chronic Care Plus | 0.00 USD | 0.00 USD | 5 | 8 | no | 180 |

Points of judgement on the figures.

1. The first card is free on every tier of the Supplemental Benefit Allowance Programmes; only a replacement is charged for, and only on the Core and Select tiers.
2. Activation is required on the Core, Select, Plus and Premier tiers. On the Dual Complete and Chronic Care Plus tiers it is not required, and the activation window figure is carried for those tiers all the same.
3. The delivery figures are quoted in business days and run from the day the card is posted.
